issues.problem: Repairable citation and contract failures in the live review pipeline did not receive bounded model feedback and full revalidation; unsafe recovery could mutate the source context, create positives from invalid responses, repeat indefinitely or use another concurrent invocation's receipt.
issues.implementation: A maximum of one conditional revision reuses the exact original source pool, per-event allowlists and discovery event catalog. Initial-response MODEL_OMITTED_EVENT_ID and MODEL_DUPLICATED_EVENT_ID fallback markers are mechanical repair triggers only when the original request hash exists; unmarked semantic uncertainty is not expanded. Each returned object is schema-checked and mechanically revalidated. Missing/duplicate targets and failures preserve the original classification. Failed transport receipts are accepted only from the invocation-bound ModelRequestFailed with consistent task, hash and failed status; shared receipt lists are never read.
issues.limitations: Passing schema, citation and contract checks does not establish clinical semantic correctness or make a physician blind-review packet. Existing original facts remain authoritative.
